main.description: Owner-only encrypted server-private article drafts. Authentication required; owner comes only from the authenticated DID. Never publishes drafts or images to the PDS. Responses use private, no-store and nosniff. Storage unavailable returns Unavailable. Saves use expectedRevision CAS and durable mutationId idempotency; tombstones never resurrect. Explicit Publish/Schedule remain separate actions. Create uses expectedRevision 0; replaying an identical mutation returns the acknowledged snapshot, while conflicting payloads or revisions return Conflict. Clients resolve unlocked cross-device conflicts by payload.updatedAt (latest edit wins); ties, tombstones, and publication/schedule claims prefer the server.

mutationId.description: Canonical lowercase UUID. This private identifier is not a PDS record.
